DurationBound.description:
Interval-censored duration in seconds; consumers fit distributions
across events, never per-event midpoints. Nothing in layer 3 is
left-censored: a left-censored start or an open end gives ``censoring =
"right"`` with ``hi`` null.

hi.description: null exactly when censoring is right.
hi.title: Hi

reported.description: Difference of the two events' reported times, when both are kept.
reported.title: Reported

uncovered_s.description: Seconds of the span not covered; null exactly when right-censored.
uncovered_s.title: Uncovered S

DurationBound.title: DurationBound

EventBound.description:
Feed-supported bound: the event happened in ``(after, by]``, integer
UTC seconds, exclusive below. ``after`` null is left-censored. ``after <
by`` strictly. A kept ``reported`` satisfies ``after < reported <= by``
(an earlier report widens ``after`` to ``reported - 1``, §3.2).

reported.description: The feed's own time, kept only inside (after, by].
reported.title: Reported

suspect_s.description: Seconds of (after, by] in legacy suspect_stale; null when after is null and on raw records.
suspect_s.title: Suspect S

uncovered_s.description: Seconds of (after, by] not covered; null when after is null.
uncovered_s.title: Uncovered S

EventBound.title: EventBound

GapInterval.description:
Current elapsed gap at an evaluation instant; integer seconds, both
ends inclusive. ``hi`` null only when the last passing is left-censored,
or for ``scheduled_no_observation``. ``OpenState`` fixes both ends (§4):
exactly ``[as_of - by, as_of - after - 1]`` with no outage.
GapInterval.title: GapInterval

description:
Right-censored state at one instant (the live store, §7; also the
window-end tail and the next day's checkpoint of a nightly build). Never
a closed record. ``current_gap`` is finite at ``as_of``; ``eventual`` is
the still-open headway, right-censored from ``current_gap.lo``.

``current_gap`` is exact (§4): with the last passing in ``(after, by]``,
``lo = max(0, as_of - max(by, e))`` and ``hi = as_of - after - 1``, where
``e`` is ``uncovered_until`` (an uncovered interval of the feed ended
after the last passing, so a train may have passed unseen) and drops
out when null. ``scheduled_no_observation`` reads ``since`` for ``by``
and has no ``hi``. ``uncovered_until`` is set exactly when the flag
``uncovered_since`` is; ``as_of`` while the feed is still uncovered,
which gives ``lo = 0``.

ambiguity_set.description: Pattern scope: one clock per series.
ambiguity_set.title: Ambiguity Set

compatible_pattern_ids.description: open_run: the live pattern fit, sorted, which may exclude a matched pattern; [] otherwise.
compatible_pattern_ids.title: Compatible Pattern Ids

current_gap.description: Exactly [as_of - max(by, uncovered_until), as_of - after - 1], lo clamped at 0 (§4); since for by with no observation.

eventual.description: The still-open headway: censoring right, hi null, lo = current_gap.lo.

last_event_evidence.description: Service evidence of last_event; null exactly when it is.
last_event_evidence.title: Last Event Evidence

last_event_seq.description: open_run only: StopEvent.seq of the last event.
last_event_seq.title: Last Event Seq

pattern_attribution.description: open_run only; scheduled_trip when matched (tiers 1-4 live).
pattern_attribution.title: Pattern Attribution

pattern_id.description: open_run: the matched pattern or the unique fit; clocks: set exactly at pattern scope.
pattern_id.title: Pattern Id

since.description: Start of the open interval (§4 initialization).
since.title: Since

source.description: The run's feed (open_run) or the route's feed (clocks).
source.title: Source

uncovered_until.description: End of the last uncovered interval of the feed after the last passing (after since with no passing), as_of while still uncovered; null when none. Set exactly with the uncovered_since flag.
uncovered_until.title: Uncovered Until
